# Otway Tree Care

> Qualified arborists providing tree removal, pruning, stump grinding, forestry mulching, hedging, property maintenance, waste removal and arborist reports/consulting across Colac, Apollo Bay and the Otways region of Victoria, Australia. Family-run, led by qualified arborist Tom Kleindienst. Fixed-price quotes, fully insured.

Contact: 0448 762 058 · otwaytc@gmail.com · 3 Arthur Court, Apollo Bay VIC 3233
Service area: Colac, Elliminyt, Birregurra, Beeac, Alvie, Winchelsea, Camperdown, Lorne, Apollo Bay, Skenes Creek, Marengo, Wye River, Forrest, Gellibrand, Barwon Downs, Beech Forest, Lavers Hill

## Services
- [Tree Removal](https://otwaytreecare.com/tree-removal.html): Hazardous and large-scale tree removal, including trees near houses and powerlines.
- [Tree Pruning](https://otwaytreecare.com/tree-pruning.html): Health and safety pruning to Australian Standards (AS 4373-2007).
- [Stump Grinding](https://otwaytreecare.com/stump-grinding.html): Deep-reach stump grinding for any size stump.
- [Emergency Tree Removal](https://otwaytreecare.com/emergency-tree-removal.html): 24/7 storm damage and hazardous tree response.
- [Forestry Mulching](https://otwaytreecare.com/forestry-mulching.html): Land clearing and invasive species (gorse, blackberry) removal.
- [Hedging](https://otwaytreecare.com/hedging.html): Hedge trimming and shaping, boundary hedges to formal gardens.
- [Property Maintenance](https://otwaytreecare.com/property-maintenance.html): Scheduled vegetation and acreage maintenance, holiday home caretaking, fire fuel reduction.
- [Waste Removal](https://otwaytreecare.com/waste-removal.html): Green waste and site cleanup.
- [Arborist Reports & Consulting](https://otwaytreecare.com/arborist-reports-consulting.html): Reports for council permits, hazard assessments and development applications.
